model_annotation: Figure 3(a) illustrates the runtime of several language models, represented as a percentage of the Vanilla model runtime, across different training-free experiments. The x-axis is labeled "Sept.L.M (n=256)" and spans a linear scale from 5 to 28, with tick labels at 5, 10, 15, 20, and 25. The y-axis is labeled "r.KV (%)" and spans a linear scale from 0 to 100, with tick labels at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100. A blue solid line with circle markers represents "Vanilla," starting at 77.79% and ending at 77.18% across the x-axis, showing a slight decline. A green dashed line with triangle markers represents "StrML.LM (n=380)," starting at 70.89% and ending at 69.67%, also exhibiting a decline. A red solid line with square markers represents "SepL.LM (n=256)," starting at 69.67% and ending at 67.18%, demonstrating a decline. A purple dashed line with diamond markers represents "SepL.LM(n=541)," starting at 66.67% and ending at 62.10%, showing a decline. A cyan solid line with x markers represents "SepL.LM(n=256)," starting at 60.49% and ending at 57.66%, also declining.
